Cargo.toml.delta: Retain the exact facade source while declaring only sqlx-core, sqlx-macros, and sqlx-sqlite. Preserve empty mysql/postgres forwarding feature names so optional upstream feature declarations resolve but fail closed if selected.

sqlx-macros/Cargo.toml.delta: Bind the exact macro source only to the local macro core and trusted SQLx core; omit MySQL/Postgres package dependencies.

sqlx-macros-core/Cargo.toml.delta: Bind macro expansion only to the trusted SQLx core and SQLite driver; omit inactive MySQL/Postgres package declarations that otherwise retain RSA in Cargo.lock.

rationale: The native TSP/Askar composition uses SQLx core, macros, and SQLite only. The trusted project-robius revision carries the required libsqlite3-sys 0.35 compatibility change. Removing unselected driver declarations eliminates an inactive vulnerable RSA lock edge without changing compiled SQLite source.
